correctness.rationale: The Singer difference-set incidence yields column weights 9 and pairwise intersection 6 for A, hence A^T A=I and H=[I|A] is a full-rank parity check and generator. The independent replay enumerates the 8,192 codewords, checks minimum distance 6, and xors each of the 83,682 distinct coordinate subsets of weights 0 through 5. They reach all 8,192 syndromes; first-hit weight and number of minimum-weight subsets reproduce all joint counts. In particular the distance counts are (1,26,325,2080,3770,1990), so covering radius is exactly 5, and the weighted sum is 31946, giving 15973/4096. Repeated-coordinate paths are not counted: alternatively each shortest Cayley path uses distinct coordinates and each minimum subset yields precisely d! such paths. The point-preserving permutations act faithfully on the syndromes, preserve the line-column set and generate a group of size 5616. The involution AR exchanges e_i with A_(.,-i) and induces a code automorphism. The two disjoint coordinate-block cosets give at least 11232 elements, which is the full-group order by Höhn. The independent orbit replay verifies all 22 rows, including the five depth-five (size, leader count) pairs (936,18), (702,18), (234,18), (117,10), (1,26), and singleton syndrome 8191. The stored and reproduced CSV SHA-256 is 8d8acd1b504b47d31e62dc0b9b4ebcb62048e9cc845561312ce678ce55279790. Replay with python3 /workspace/branches/df660689-3bb2-49e8-8d07-ffb023b0ed89/independent_check.py. The uploaded verifier was inspected, not run. Uniqueness up to coordinate permutation is imported from the classification, not proved by enumerating this one code.
residual_risks: The computation proves finite invariants of one exact representative, and their transfer uses the cited equivalence-class theorem. It does not classify arbitrary self-dual codes or infer a length-dependent bound.

evidence: The group order provides only a bound and divisibility condition on orbit sizes. The weight enumerator supplies normalization and min distance, not the individual minimum-error support counts in each nonzero syndrome. claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The odd-Golay construction and known code invariants do not mechanically imply the distribution; the new calculation must exhaust distinct syndrome subsets and explicitly partition the induced action. The exact numerical counts cannot be transplanted from a different code merely because the method is analogous.

evidence: Höhn's code is defined by projective-plane non-incidence and is the same code up to equivalence. Its odd-Golay deep-hole discussion is for the length-24 code in the descent, not the length-26 code.
Resultary's analogous joint distance/tie census and orbit decomposition is for the [15,6,5] Petersen cycle code.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Nearest-codeword list sizes agree with minimum-support syndrome counts via the coset bijection. For a self-dual code the dual is the same code. Neither alternative formulation identifies a length-24 deep-hole orbit or a different cycle code with the length-26 syndrome space and census.

value.rationale: This is a natural, complete nearest-decoding and symmetry invariant of the unique extremal self-dual code at its length, not an arbitrary chosen subset of syndromes. The 1990 deepest cosets split into five different symmetry types, with exact tie sizes including a full-group-fixed exceptional coset. Those distinctions supply data for decoding and comparisons of symmetry classes that the established weight enumerator and group order do not provide.
residual_risks: Value is an exact finite decoding classification; no new construction, optimal covering bound, or across-length result is asserted.
